summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph, with a nested recursive helper add_to_cbd implementing CBD rules 1–3 (subject triples, blank-node expansion with cycle guard, and reifier triples via rdf:subject). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule 1/2 and reification counts, incoming reification, blank-node non-expansion through reification, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified; expected counts were checked by hand against the fixture. Nothing committed.
